blockingFindings.description: V71 direct inspection of all five views and six pose renders, corroborated by Astra, still shows conspicuous angular faceting and accordion-like folds along side and rear skirt panels. The widened matched front/lap-side hem endpoints do not resolve the overall drape.

V71 sit and crouch renders still expose substantial anterior and upper thigh areas as the front panels pull aside and bunch laterally. The 40 mm matched flank extension has not established continuous lap coverage.
The rear waist adjustment tab remains small and indistinct at full-body scale; the back view does not make its function legible.

The existing render-current path regenerated topology and UV showcase from the V71 Blender source (source SHA-256 3a76540ef7ad47183571abffcdc3b1e86bef62ab7f9b12f68856570038030b4e).
